title: The stone head, from behind
logline: The carved face from the back: the rough uncut stone, moss, a date chiseled and unreadable, the shingle wall it leans toward. The monument nobody remembers, from the side that never had a face.

panels.composition: The back of a carved stone head, waist-high, half sunk in wet grass by a shingle wall: uncut rough stone, moss in the tool marks, a chiseled line of numerals rubbed to nothing but a shape. The pup sniffing the base. Beyond, the wall, and the roofline of the town.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, the back of a moss-grown carved stone head half sunk in wet grass beside a shingle wall, rough uncut stone with tool marks and an unreadable chiseled date, a small three-legged dog sniffing its base, a small town's rooflines beyond, no words
image.notes: The date is reserved: draw it as an eroded shape.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
